faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Raipur Editorial Assistant (Intern) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Raipur Editorial Assistant (Intern) position is 08-08-2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Editorial Assistant (Intern) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (MA) in English or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university with a strong academic record.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Editorial Assistant (Intern) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Editorial Assistant (Intern) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Editorial Assistant (Intern) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Editorial Assistant (Intern) position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by scrutiny.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Editorial Assistant (Intern) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Raipur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 493661.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIM Raipur or the provided application link before the last date.
